name: InterContinental Shanghai Puxi Hotel
insider_take: A sophisticated gateway to Shanghai's historic heart, where French Concession elegance meets modern luxury in the city's cultural epicenter.
whats_special: Located in the prestigious Puxi district, this InterContinental sits mere steps from Shanghai's legendary French Concession—once home to diplomats and dignitaries. The hotel occupies a prime position near Huaihai Road, Shanghai's answer to the Champs-Élysées, where Art Deco architecture tells stories of the city's glamorous 1930s era. The property features direct access to some of Shanghai's most coveted shopping and dining, including the tree-lined avenues that house century-old plane trees originally planted by French colonists.
pro_tip: Book a room facing north for stunning views of People's Square and the historic Shanghai Museum—you'll witness the perfect juxtaposition of old and new Shanghai from your window.
dont_miss: Explore the nearby Xintiandi district, built around preserved 1920s shikumen (stone gate) houses that now house upscale boutiques and restaurants. Take a 10-minute walk to Fuxing Park, where locals practice tai chi at dawn among rose gardens and French-style landscaping. The hotel's proximity to the former residence of Sun Yat-sen and the Communist Party's First Congress site makes it a perfect base for history enthusiasts.
